artworks.title: Sixteen East Gay Street
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a street scene viewed from a level perspective. There is a hint of a horizon with streets, buildings, trees, and structures in the distance. It is created using monochromatic tones, likely through lithographic techniques. The fine black and white detailing and shading provide texture to the trees, people, and buildings. The image features a palette of predominantly grays and blacks on a white background. Closest to the viewer, a man stands next to a bicycle while another person bends down, potentially fixing it. Figures are seen chatting on porches and walking along the path in the background, adding to the lively street setting.

artworks.title: Sunday 1897
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows four people in a horse-drawn carriage. All four individuals are visible from head to foot as they sit in the vehicle. The person on the far left is an older man with a beard, wearing a hat and a formal suit, gesturing with his hand. Next to him is a younger man with short hair, wearing a boater hat and a striped suit. Behind them is another older man seated with a slightly hunched posture, holding a document or paper. On the right side sits an older woman dressed in a large, patterned garment with a bonnet, holding a small folding fan. The carriage is covered with a fringed canopy. In the background, two horses are partially visible. The setting includes a picket fence, trees, a house in the distance, and two women standing near the fence on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Tennis
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a park scene with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, marked by a line of trees framing the scene, with a cloudy sky visible beyond. The brushstrokes are detailed, providing texture to the trees and figures. The shading is soft, adding depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black creating contrast between light and shadow. A group of people is gathered, some sitting and others standing, watching or playing tennis. More figures are across the grassy area, engaged in leisure activities. Trees flank the scene, and a structure with arches is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Tennis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a park scene with numerous figures engaged in leisure activities. People are sitting or in motion, creating a dynamic atmosphere. The park is surrounded by large trees, offering shaded areas with sunlight filtering through. Some figures hold umbrellas. The drawing captures the play of light and shadow, emphasizing a lively yet relaxed mood.

artworks.title: Studies of Jean
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and neck. The main portrait features the individual in a three-quarter profile, looking to the left. They have youthful facial features with long, smooth hair. Surrounding the main portrait are additional sketches showing the lower part of the face and a side profile of an eye and brow. The background is a plain, light-colored paper. There are no accessories or objects depicted in the sketch.

artworks.title: The Cross in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: graphite with gray-green, green-brown, and white chalk on gray paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund

artworks.title: Studies for "Washington Crossing the Delaware" [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund

artworks.title: Study of Half-Length Figure with Pole [verso]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a person's upper body. The individual is leaning forward and appears to be engaging in an activity such as swinging or striking with an elongated tool. Their facial features are lightly outlined, and they have short hair or a tied headband. The attire is simple with long sleeves. The background is plain paper with faint pencil marks.

artworks.title: Shepard Alonzo Mount, Age Twenty-Three [recto]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person seated at a table. The individual is leaning forward with their arm resting on the table. They are facing away from the viewer, showing their side profile. The person has medium-length tousled hair covering part of their forehead. They wear a jacket with a high collar and a shirt. Their right hand holds a pen, writing on a piece of paper, while the left hand rests on the table holding the paper. An inkpot is on the table next to the document. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sketch of a Standing Man [verso]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch on a lightly aged piece of paper, showing a faint full-body outline of a person positioned slightly to the left side of the composition. The person appears to stand upright, but details are not clearly defined. Vague lines suggest the person might be wearing a hat and a long garment, possibly a coat or robe. The facial features are not discernible due to the lightness of the sketch. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background of the image is plain, with some visible texture and discoloration likely due to the paper's condition.

artworks.title: Arms of a Boxer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel and Rita Fraad
artworks.description: This image depicts a sketch showing partial views of a human body, focusing on the arms and upper torso. The body is positioned with both arms raised, one bent at the elbow, and the other extending upwards. The head is outlined without detailed features. The drawn lines suggest muscles and definition in the arms but do not depict any clothing or jewelry. The background of the image remains plain.

artworks.title: Bather on the Beach
artworks.medium: black crayon with blue and gray wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Jacob Kainen in honor of Charles Parkhurst
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a simplified human form amidst abstract shapes. The drawing features a minimalist representation of a body, sketched with fluid black lines, depicting the back of a figure. The figure is set against a backdrop of geometrically abstract elements, including a prominent triangle in the upper left corner and a curved form in the lower right. These abstract shapes are accented with dabs of blue color. The use of minimal lines suggests form while allowing broad interpretation. The strategic use of blue provides an aesthetic contrast to the monochrome sketching.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.5 x 5.9 cm (2 9/16 x 2 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one large and one small. The larger figure is carrying the smaller figure on his shoulder. The larger figure has a muscular build, a long beard and hair, and wears a simple garment tied at the waist with rolled-up sleeves. He holds onto a tree trunk for support as he wades through water. The smaller figure, sitting atop the larger figure's shoulder, has curly hair and raises one hand with a gentle gesture. The smaller figure wears a flowing robe. There are no visible pieces of jewelry on the figures. The background includes a village, a church, trees, hills, and a sky with rays emanating from a central sun.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial event witnessed by a group of armored individuals on the ground. The image shows two figures reclining on clouds in the sky, radiating light downwards. Below them, a group of armored figures on horseback and on foot appear startled or in shock, with dynamic poses. The composition uses bold, sweeping lines. The sky above is filled with swirling clouds and emanating rays. The clean, black ink line work creates a striking contrast against the light background. The background includes a sparse landscape with a small structure and trees.

artworks.title: Two Nude Youths [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white, contours (of standing figure) incised, on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: There are two sketches of nude figures. On the right, a person is standing with crossed arms and tilted head. On the left, another figure is seated with one arm resting on a raised knee.

artworks.title: Half-Length of Mary Magdalene [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a woman's upper body. She is positioned with her body slightly turned to the side and her head tilted downward with her eyes closed. Her facial features are softly sketched, with long hair flowing down her shoulders. She appears unclothed, with her upper torso and arms visible. Her left arm is drawn holding an ornate vase or container against her body. The background is a plain, textured surface, possibly a blue-tinted parchment.

artworks.title: Saint Nicholas
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure wearing ecclesiastical robes and a mitre on their head. The person has a solemn expression, short hair, and is holding a staff and a book. The attire includes a decorative piece around the neck. The background is plain, with a faint halo encircling the head.

artworks.title: Rocks Along a Lakeshore [recto]
artworks.creditLine: American Art Curator's Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is placed at the upper third of the image, featuring a rocky structure with vegetation. Distant hills or mountains are visible above the horizon. The drawing is detailed and refined in pencil with a monochromatic color palette of black and grey. A large boulder in water, trees, and rocky formations with shrubbery are depicted, emphasizing natural elements in the landscape.

artworks.title: Bridge over Rocky Stream [top verso]
artworks.creditLine: American Art Curator's Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two sketches on a single page. In the top sketch, a wooden bridge spans a calm river with trees and rocks nearby and distant mountains. The bottom sketch features a rocky landscape with boulders and faint water hints. Small silhouetted figures give scale. Both sketches use delicate lines, black and white tones, and detailed textures.

artworks.title: The Harbor of Seville
artworks.creditLine: American Art Curator's Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a view from a slightly elevated perspective overlooking a body of water towards a structure and ships. Small boats are seen moving across the water, with figures visible inside them. In the distance, a large cylindrical tower stands surrounded by tall ships with billowing sails. The sky is filled with soft, sweeping clouds in pastel tones of pink, peach, and light blue. Additional buildings and trees line the horizon, merging with the sky in a gentle gradient. The scene is depicted with intricate details and a precise brush technique, capturing a tranquil and picturesque setting.

artworks.title: Witchcraft Scene with a Vampire [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown iron gall ink over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and sweeping curves in an abstract composition. Within the shapes are hints of familiar structures, including a possible human figure. Geometrical shapes resembling architectural elements are present in the backdrop, along with a dark vertical figure. The drawing evokes images of smoke or clouds.

artworks.title: Saint Ambrose Suppressing Heresy
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash heightened with white, squared in graphite; lower left corner redrawn on an insert
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man in a robe and mantle, standing with one hand extended and the other holding a book. He has long, curly hair and a flowing beard. Around him is an ornate chair or throne. A winged figure is above him to the right, with a light stream from a triangular form. Another smaller figure is depicted on the ground, holding a scroll and looking up. The background includes buildings.

artworks.title: A Man Leaning on a Structure
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink on fragment of a printed title page
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person in a leaning position. The figure is shown from the knees up, resting against a railing or similar structure. The facial features are indistinct, with shadows suggesting eyes and a tilted head, with hair that appears to be roughly sketched or covered. The clothing is loose-fitting and draped, with shadows indicating folds. A bundled object is hanging from the person's waist. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain, with faint text in red and black partially obscured by the figure.

artworks.title: Cathedral in a Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed architectural drawing of a large gothic-style building positioned prominently to the right and extending towards the center. The horizon is low, allowing the intricate details of the structure to dominate the scene. The building features towering spires, an ornate dome, and fine brushstrokes highlighting its elaborate features. The color palette is mainly monochromatic with shades of brown and grey, enhancing the drawing's depth. The terrain is rocky and foliated with trees on the sides. Softly sketched hills in the background create a sense of openness and distance.
